purpose: One-shot external confirmation of the already-fixed pre-v3 SBS-EA whole-method outputs before locking the AAAI-27 route.

external_dataset.duration_policy: Preserve official nonnegative durations, including zero-duration operations.

inference.primary_estimand: Comparator minus LLM-source external relative gap for the complete returned-rule pipeline.
inference.unit: physical external instance after averaging fixed returned rules within source
inference.operator_estimand: No-operator minus full-EA external relative gap, averaged over the 30 frozen pairs within physical instance.

go_rule.pass: Every primary external source comparison has a strictly positive 95% bootstrap lower bound.

information_boundary.cross_route_disclosure: The same external instance panel was previously used for the separately frozen macro-free v3 route; no pre-v3 candidate-B rule was selected or modified from that result.
prohibited_after_freeze: changing external instance membership or references
